verses.text: For the choirmaster. According to Mahalath. A Maskil of David. The fool says in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt; their ways are vile. There is no one who does good.

xrefs.text: In his pride the wicked man does not seek Him; in all his schemes there is no God.
For the choirmaster. Of David. The fool says in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt; their acts are vile. There is no one who does good.
As it is written: “There is no one righteous, not even one.
But God said to him, ‘You fool! This very night your life will be required of you. Then who will own what you have accumulated?
Furthermore, since they did not see fit to acknowledge God, He gave them up to a depraved mind, to do what ought not to be done.

verses.text: God looks down from heaven upon the sons of men to see if any understand, if any seek God.

xrefs.text: Seek the LORD while He may be found; call on Him while He is near.

So he went out to meet Asa and said to him, “Listen to me, Asa and all Judah and Benjamin. The LORD is with you when you are with Him. If you seek Him, He will be found by you, but if you forsake Him, He will forsake you.
My heart said, “Seek His face.” Your face, O LORD, I will seek.
For My eyes are on all their ways. They are not hidden from My face, and their guilt is not concealed from My eyes.
“Can a man hide in secret places where I cannot see him?” declares the LORD. “Do I not fill the heavens and the earth?” declares the LORD.

verses.text: All have turned away, they have together become corrupt; there is no one who does good, not even one.

xrefs.text: All have turned away, they have together become worthless; there is no one who does good, not even one.”
Each of us has become like something unclean, and all our righteous acts are like filthy rags; we all wither like a leaf, and our iniquities carry us away like the wind.
We all like sheep have gone astray, each one has turned to his own way; and the LORD has laid upon Him the iniquity of us all.
All have turned away, they have together become corrupt; there is no one who does good, not even one.
Why then have these people turned away? Why does Jerusalem always turn away? They cling to deceit; they refuse to return.

verses.text: Will the workers of iniquity never learn? They devour my people like bread; they refuse to call upon God.

xrefs.text: “For My people are fools; they have not known Me. They are foolish children, without understanding. They are skilled in doing evil, but they know not how to do good.”

Pour out Your wrath on the nations that do not acknowledge You, and on the families that do not call on Your name. For they have devoured Jacob; they have consumed him and finished him off; they have devastated his homeland.
When the wicked came upon me to devour my flesh, my enemies and foes stumbled and fell.

When its limbs are dry, they are broken off. Women come and use them for kindling; for this is a people without understanding. Therefore their Maker has no compassion on them, and their Creator shows them no favor.
Take notice, O senseless among the people! O fools, when will you be wise?

verses.text: There they are, overwhelmed with dread, where there was nothing to fear. For God has scattered the bones of those who besieged you. You put them to shame, for God has despised them.

xrefs.text: The wicked flee when no one pursues, but the righteous are as bold as a lion.

As for those of you who survive, I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies, so that even the sound of a windblown leaf will put them to flight. And they will flee as one flees the sword, and fall when no one pursues them.
They are called rejected silver, because the LORD has rejected them.”
As when one plows and breaks up the soil, so our bones have been scattered at the mouth of Sheol.
I will lay the corpses of the Israelites before their idols and scatter your bones around your altars.

verses.text: Oh, that the salvation of Israel would come from Zion! When God restores His captive people, let Jacob rejoice, let Israel be glad!

xrefs.text: Oh, that the salvation of Israel would come from Zion! When the LORD restores His captive people, let Jacob rejoice, let Israel be glad!

This is what the LORD says: “I will restore the fortunes of Jacob’s tents and have compassion on his dwellings. And the city will be rebuilt on her own ruins, and the palace will stand in its rightful place.
Cry out and sing, O citizen of Zion, for great among you is the Holy One of Israel.”
On that day they offered great sacrifices, rejoicing because God had given them great joy. The women and children also rejoiced, so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard from afar.
A song of ascents. When the LORD restored the captives of Zion, we were like dreamers.
